chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him), when he appointed deputies to the army commanders.
ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's letter to the army commanders upon becoming Caliph?
ai.summary: This introductory phrase from Nahj al-Balagha marks the commencement of Imam Ali’s (AS) directive to the provincial military governors (Amir al-Mu'minin's military leaders) during the early years of his caliphate, a period marked by the consolidation of authority and the Battle of the Camel. It establishes the foundational context for his subsequent instructions on justice, fiscal responsibility, and military discipline, reflecting the administrative rigor of the Rashidun era under Shia scholarly interpretation.
